notes: Baseline half of the LUM-1330 A/B: the same extension file WITHOUT a `tool_call` handler, so the tool runs.

The command is `printf %s%s RUNAWAY _MARKER`: the marker is assembled at run time, so the transcript can only contain the contiguous string `RUNAWAY_MARKER` if the shell actually ran and its stdout was rendered.
Run it with: python3 pi-rust/scripts/fake_model_server.py --port 8137 --tool bash --arguments '{"command": "printf %s%s RUNAWAY _MARKER"}'
caption: LUM-1330 baseline: with no `tool_call` handler the command runs, so `RUNAWAY_MARKER` (assembled by the shell at run time) shows up in the transcript together with the tool's duration line. Compare with lum1330-tool-hooks.png, where the same command is blocked and the marker never appears.
